Account security

Why this fixture exists. The inline-icon work shipped a defect that killed the Stage-5 TOTP save banner: an uncaught ReferenceError thrown while building the first icon aborted the rest of the content script, including observeTotpCandidates. No existing fixture could reproduce it — the TOTP candidate pages (otpauth-link, manual-key, qr) have no fillable field, so no icon is ever built there and nothing throws; and the pages with fields (login, login-with-otp) carry no TOTP candidate, so the banner has nothing to offer. The two conditions never met. This page holds both.

Open in authenticator app

Expect both at once: the key icon in the username and password fields, and the «Save 2FA to MyPass?» banner in the bottom-right corner. If the icon appears but the banner does not, the content script threw after attaching icons — check the page console for an exception.
